projects.name: Foxconn | Apple Manufacturing Campus
projects.summary: Preferred-vendor execution across 10+ work orders for one of India's most demanding electronics manufacturing environments. UEL has received 10+ work orders at the Foxconn | Apple manufacturing campus, reflecting its position as a preferred execution partner for fast-track, high-precision works. The scope spans MEPF, civil sections, industrial BMS and precision engineering piping, including clean-room and process utility networks. UEL's role has required exceptional pace, strict sequencing and coordinated execution across multiple active work fronts.

projects.name: JSW EV Manufacturing Facility
projects.summary: JSW is establishing a world-class 636-acre Electric Vehicle (EV) and Hybrid Vehicle manufacturing facility in the AURIC Bidkin region, Maharashtra. The project comprises a 546-acre passenger vehicle manufacturing unit and a 90-acre commercial vehicle manufacturing unit. The integrated facility will produce electric passenger cars, hybrid vehicles, and critical EV components, with a planned annual production capacity of up to 500,000 passenger vehicles and 100,000 commercial vehicles. MEP Excellence Driving the Future of Mobility.

projects.name: Tata Electronics Semiconductor Programme
projects.summary: 5+ project packages supporting India's emerging semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Tata Electronics is developing a large-scale semiconductor ecosystem across Dholera and Assam, including a wafer fabrication facility in Gujarat and a semiconductor assembly and testing facility in Assam. UEL has secured 5+ project packages with a combined value of INR 120+ Cr, supporting critical infrastructure works across both locations. The mandate includes MEPF services, infrastructure and trestle piping, civil infra for piping, electrical works in Dholera and HVAC works in Assam.

The project highlights UEL's capability to integrate mechanical systems with digital controls in sustainability-led institutional infrastructure.
